Sam K: midshift check-in — warmed a few shard lanes, ran quick microbench on kernel v0.9.3
Priya R: nice, numbers?
Sam K: 95th latency down from 42ms -> 34ms on 1k seq, throughput +8%
Jules: what's changed? kernel scheduling tweak?
Sam K: changed microbatch prefetch window + reduced slot hold to 6ms; also bumped AX kernel priority
Chris L: opened a tiny PR: https://git.redwood/infra/runtime/pull/214 — benchmark script + test
Priya R: will review in a bit, FYI prefetch evict test still flaky on canary
Marta: saw OOM on canary node3 @ 14:12 — logs: `oom: kv_cache_alloc failed`
Sam K: ack, I'm bisecting now, likely regression from recent kv-caching change
deploy-bot: canary deploy v0.9.3->v0.9.4 started (canary=2/10)
Jules: if bisect shows it's the kv change, can we gate with feature flag? we need quick rollback path
Sam K: yes, adding feature flag `kv_prefetch_v2` and will gate in runtime config
Priya R: blockers? need anything from SRE or infra?
Sam K: need a quick node repro with 16GB mem to run full evict cycle, pinged infra
Chris L: I'll queue the review and add perf microbench to the PR
Marta: FYI I captured heap profile: https://files.redwood/heap123.pb
Sam K: thanks, will include in bisect notes
Priya R: sounds good — update here when you have bisect result :thumbsup:
